WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date = '201301'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        MIN(Consumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM segment_consumption
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_min AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM segment_min
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),
segment_avg_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CustomerID,
        s1.Segment,
        s1.AvgConsumption - s2.AvgConsumption AS AvgConsumptionDiff
    FROM segment_avg s1
    JOIN segment_avg s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
),
segment_avg_diff_min AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CustomerID,
        s1.Segment,
        s1.AvgConsumption - s2.AvgConsumption AS AvgConsumptionDiff
    FROM segment_avg s1
    JOIN segment_avg s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
    WHERE s1.Segment = 'SME'
),
segment_avg_diff_lam_kam AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CustomerID,
        s1.Segment,
        s1.AvgConsumption - s2.AvgConsumption AS AvgConsumptionDiff
    FROM segment_avg s1
    JOIN segment_avg s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
    WHERE s1.Segment = 'LAM'
),
segment_avg_diff_kam_sme AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CustomerID,
        s1.Segment,
        s1.AvgConsumption - s2.AvgConsumption AS AvgConsumptionDiff
    FROM segment_avg s1
    JOIN segment_avg s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
    WHERE s1.Segment = 'KAM'
),
segment_avg_diff_sme_lam AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CustomerID,
        s1.Segment,
        s1.AvgConsumption - s2.AvgConsumption AS AvgConsumptionDiff
    FROM segment_avg s1
    JOIN segment_avg s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
    WHERE s1.Segment = 'SME'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN s1.Segment = 'SME' AND s2.Segment = 'LAM' THEN s1.AvgConsumptionDiff
        WHEN s1.Segment = 'LAM' AND s2.Segment = 'KAM' THEN s1.AvgConsumptionDiff
        WHEN s1.Segment = 'KAM' AND s2.Segment = 'SME' THEN s1.AvgConsumptionDiff
    END AS AvgConsumptionDiff
FROM segment_avg_diff s1
JOIN segment_avg_diff_min s2 ON s1.CustomerID = s2.CustomerID AND s1.Segment = s2.Segment
WHERE s1.Segment = 'SME' AND s2.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as TotalPatients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as InpatientCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as OutpatientCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as MaleInpatient,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as MaleOutpatient,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' AND SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100,
        2
    ) as MaleDeviationPercentage
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Examination.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination)
GROUP BY Examination.ID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY MaleDeviationPercentage DESC

ORDER BY MaleDeviationPercentage DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id
JOIN Player p ON t.team_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT SUM(bu)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
    WHERE ta2.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id
      AND strftime('%Y', ta2.date) = '2012'
      AND ta2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ta.buildUpPlayPassing DESC

SELECT 
    cr.name AS constructorName,
    cr.nationality AS constructorNationality,
    COUNT(*) AS constructorScore
FROM constructors cr
JOIN races r ON cr.constructorId = r.constructorId
JOIN races r2 ON r2.year = r.year
WHERE r2.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
  AND r2.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
GROUP BY cr.constructorId, cr.name, cr.nationality
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY constructorScore DESC
LIMIT 1
